resolution: Self-inflicted, resolved not deleted. The NHL API and ESPN's injury feed do not agree on abbreviation style: the NHL returns LAK/NJD/SJS/TBL and ESPN returns LA/NJ/SJ/TB. Every ESPN injury row for those four clubs failed to resolve, so four franchises had no injury context feeding the injury-gated strategies at all while this queue recorded 11-13 unmappable entries. Fixed on 2026-09-22 by the ABBREV_ALIASES table in store.py, applied only when the abbreviation is not already a team in its own right. Re-probe the flag by re-ingesting: if any entry still cannot be mapped, _injury_context raises a fresh flag with the count.
